what: Per-file two-way agreement between the pinned Lean and `clean check` on the import-free files of Lean's own tests/elab (Lean accepts) and tests/elab_fail (Lean rejects). Written by scripts/lean_suite_conformance.py --update; never hand-edited. `clean-accepts-lean-rejects` rows are the silent-acceptance face and may only fall.

tests_source.found_via: --tests-root / $LEAN4_TESTS_DIR, else $HOME/lean4-src/tests (where the 2026-09-24 critic's driver read them); the pinned toolchain ships src/lean but no tests

selection: every *.lean in elab/ and elab_fail/ whose text, with Lean comments and string literals blanked, has no import/prelude/module line, and that has no sibling <file>.*.sh or <file>.*.flags

clean.verdict_rule: non-zero exit = reject; exit 0 = accept only when the printed Clean-check-report-v1 records no parser_recovery, else accept-partial (never an agreement with a Lean acceptance; a false accept against a Lean rejection)

rebases.reason: Round-4 red sweep, 2026-10-18. Policy, not elaboration (29de4ae8b, 2026-09-25: `clean check` refuses a run that checked no declaration and fails a declaration that uses an explicit `sorry`; Lean exits 0 with a warning): commands only -- elab/1274.lean 1571 2009 382 764 801 UnexpandSubtype binder_predicates constDelab intModBug localGlobalNotation namespaceHyg negFloat ppBeta ppNotationCode; an explicit sorry only -- elab/1235.lean 1308 3524 500_lean3 quotInd unfoldDefEq unfoldReduceMatch. Frontend gaps, each an OPEN class in docs/FRONTEND_CLASS_LEDGER.md: elab/tryPostponeIssue.lean (a notation operand that is not an identifier, in a pattern position, refused since ebcf3eb20); elab/simpUnfoldAbbrev.lean (simp keys a hypothesis rule without reducible unfolding) and elab/zetaDeltaSet.lean (no zetaDelta for a let variable named in a simp set), both closed through simp's assumption closer until 13b314065 turned it off for the surface simp, as Lean has it.
